payload.title: File:Just Checking!!! (19327495065).jpg
payload.artist_html: Andy Morffew from Itchen Abbas, Hampshire, UK
payload.description_html:
Every time one of the Roller adults left their nest after feeding their chicks, they spent a few minutes looking out of the nest hole. I just assumed they were looking out for predators but a few times they saw something tasty on the ground and flew down and caught it.

Taken in Hungary.
